assetStatus: Already implemented — a hand-built React Three Fiber scene (EarthSpaceViewer.tsx, mode="seasons"), not a pending asset. Earth renders from the same real, already-cleared GLB used by the Solar System branch.
visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier quality bar: warm off-white studio backdrop, no floor grid, no glow/bloom. Earth's axis is drawn tilted at the learner-set angle and stays pointed in a fixed world direction while the orbit-position slider moves Earth around the Sun, so the changing sunlit-hemisphere is read directly off real-time directional lighting.
materialNotes: Earth uses its existing real GLB material set (metallic-roughness PBR); no emissive channels — the day/night split is real-time directional lighting from the Sun position, not a baked texture.
note: Process-driven component: the 'Touch it' interaction is a live physics simulation (tilt-angle and orbit-position sliders, season presets) rather than tapping points on a single model, so this component intentionally carries no hotspots.
